The face geometry that the subclass adds (functional-equation mirror pairs at Re ~ 0.125227/0.874773, density bounds) constrains only the OFF-LINE zeros, which carry only the fedge*k machine signature already in the identity; the S-ROUTE is carried by the ON-LINE unknown zeros, and no h = 1 pair-correlation result available from known mathematics (unconditional pair correlation is mean-value / positive-proportion, structurally incapable of forcing a sup below the mean) can beat it. (2) NEW REALIZED WALL (formal T4OffLR, strict rationals, full tree 17454 jobs 0 errors): the machine identity fluc = K + fedge*k_face + S-route with MEASURED fluc = 236.273255 and CORRECTED K = -218.893831 (dps-60 dual integrators, GATE 1/2 at 1e-7) pins the ACTUAL S-route = 455.167086 - 27.970831*k for the true face count k (0 <= k <= 14, 0275; on-line window count 8 measured day080, separate fixed term). Certified lower bounds (fluc_lo 236.27, (-K)_lo 218.87, fedge_hi 27.98): S-route_lo(k) = 455.14 - 27.98k; k = 0: 455.14 (1.7225x the gate 264.2366); k = 6: 287.26 (1.0871x - STILL ABOVE the gate); k = 7: 259.28 (falls below: the readings k >= 7 are gate-consistent). So under the typical face readings k <= 6 (7 of the 15 admissible), the gate constant is BELOW the S-route the machine ACTUALLY MEASURED: a sup-form theorem at gate strength is refuted by the real world, and the k-ambiguity (0270) is the only escape - precisely the many-face-zero readings k >= 7, the far-from-RH regime. CT-2 UNIT CORRIGENDUM (recorded per honesty convention, 0282 values preserved): the 0282 CT-2 pinning (798ac10) carried unit errors - (i) '9.45 S-units = 264.24 fluc / 27.97 fluc-per-S-jump' was a fabricated conversion: the fluc/K/fedge/E_win machine quantities are ALREADY S-units (1/pi argument scale); the requirement is 264.2433 S-units piece-total = c* * span = 2.5821 x 102.334, not 9.45; (ii) '20.6 S-units over the 52-unit piece' was a wrong span: the kernel mass is W1+W2 = 102.334 (S-effect per unit zero density, 0274 g2 kernel) and the first moment is E1 = 4.1199 x 102.334 = 421.6058 S-units piece-total; (iii) '61.9x margin under RH' / '2.21x stronger than under-RH' / '46% below the first moment' followed from (i)-(ii): CGG Theorem 1 bounds |S(t+h)-S(t)| (TOTAL S, value scale, h <= sqrt(t) = 1.73e6 t-units at tPT2) - a different object from the count-scale S-route (unknown-zero count in the kernel mass, mean 421.6); under RH the S-route IS the zero count (first moment 421.6), so the 1.596 wall stands as a bound comparison even under RH, and the correct circularity statement is VACUITY (under RH the face is empty directly, no S-route bound needed); '46%' is replaced by the true 37.3% (264.2433/421.6058 = 0.6267) already in 0281. CT-3 verdict: no conformant-subclass mechanism available from known mathematics beats the first moment; the subclass route is closed. CT remains the single open work item of the RH program (next: CT-4 formalization of the t-profile realized wall - t3/t4 realized floors 321.38/400.29 S-units, ratios 1.586x/1.600x - and the full record).
